_doc: claude/reality1 rule bldclass-evidence: real post-war balcony blocks seen on Google Street View 2026-11-26 (look only, nothing kept) that must stay balcony blocks (tools/audit/bldclassCheck.mjs F)

trueBlocks.name: Av. du Chateau de Walzin 13: 1970s-80s brown brick, continuous balconies on 5 floors, a steep tiled roof with dormers (the case that limits the steep-roof rule to row fronts / small blocks)
Av. Winston Churchill 123: a 9-storey stone-clad post-war block, a column of balconies, between two Beaux-Arts houses (its neighbour's inventory record must not date it)
Av. Winston Churchill 242 (Longchamp): an 8-storey block with full-width glass balconies (a bare 1913 inventory record sits inside its footprint)
Av. Messidor 206: the 1973 stepped brutalist blocks with continuous balcony terraces
Rue Colonel Chaltin 32: a 5-storey brick and concrete block with balconies on every floor (UrbIS reads its roof as steep: a free-standing block keeps the draw)
